title: WRIS Distance from River & Drainage Density — Assam Revenue Circles
description: Average distance from river and drainage density per Revenue Circle in Assam, used as hazard-conditioning covariates in the IDS-DRR Assam flood risk model.
purpose: River-proximity and drainage covariates for the IDS-DRR Assam flood risk score model.
details: This dataset was missing entirely from the first draft of this repo's RDLS metadata; added after cross-checking against the risk model's data dictionary and this repo's own Sources/README.md (which lists 'Distance from rivers' and 'Drainage density' together under a 'WRIS' row, One Time / static). CONFLICT TO RESOLVE WITH THE TEAM: the risk model's data_dictionary.csv attributes drainage-density's datasource as 'NASADEM' instead (methodologically plausible, since drainage density is commonly derived from a DEM via flow-accumulation analysis), while this repo's own top-level Sources/README.md groups it under WRIS alongside distance-from-river. Both master/distance_from_river_polygon.csv and master/drainage_density.csv are computed as 'onetime_variables' in Sources/master2.py, consistent with them being a related pair — this file follows that repo-internal grouping (WRIS) rather than the model dictionary's NASADEM attribution, but the discrepancy should be resolved rather than silently picked one way. distance-from-river has no license recorded in the data dictionary; drainage-density likewise has none recorded there.

sources.name: WRIS-derived river proximity and drainage density (exact source product unconfirmed; drainage density's methodology suggests DEM-derived, possibly from NASADEM — see 'details')
